title: Retrieval teams for crashed triangular craft

tellings.quote: I know a man two different people who've been on the retrieval teams of the triangular ones.

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime campaigner for UFO disclosure, tells Michels that he knows two different people who served on retrieval teams sent to recover crashed craft of the triangular kind. He gives no names, places or dates, and passes it on as what those men told him. If true, it would mean someone has been quietly collecting downed triangular craft.
